edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff the settlement amount agreed in writing by the parties (the “Settlement Amount”) within 30 days after both parties execute this Agreement, by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff.
edits.name: Payment

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Effective only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from all claims, whether known or unknown, arising out of or relating to the matters alleged in the dispute between Plaintiff and Defendant through the date this Agreement is executed. This release does not cover obligations under this Agreement or claims arising after its execution.
edits.name: Release

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except that either party may disclose them to its legal, tax, and financial advisers, insurers, auditors, or as required by law, court order, or regulatory process, or as reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement. A party making a permitted disclosure to an adviser shall inform the adviser of the confidential nature of the terms.
edits.name: Confidentiality
